question: Who is the Member Secretary of the Rajiv Gandhi Science and Technology Commission?
gold_answer: Shri Narendra Shah, retired professor, IIT Bombay, appointed by the GR of 02-11-2021. Earlier Shri Anil Shrikrishna Manekar (GR of 19-07-2019), who asked to be relieved before his term ended

gold_grs_detail.title: Appointment on the post of Member Secretory, Rajiv Gandhi Science and Technology Commission  Shri. A.S.Manekar.
Appointment to the post of Member Secretary, Rajiv Gandhi Science and Technology Commission, Mumbai- Mr. Narendra Shah, Retired Professor, Indian Institute of Technology, Mumbai.

product.answer: The 2019 GR appointed Shri. A.S. Manekar as Member Secretary of the Rajiv Gandhi Science and Technology Commission. The 2021 GR replaced him by appointing Shri. Narendra Shah to that post. No newer GR in the corpus amends, extends, or clarifies the 2019 GR beyond this replacement.
